_doc: The chapter, one row per scene, played in order. bg = a Katawa Shoujo background tag ('bg <name>'), music = a KS music alias (store.music_<alias>), present = characters on screen in the order they react to camo changes (first one reacts). ops: ['say', who, expr|null, text] | ['n', text] | ['show', who, expr, xpos 'left'|'center'|'right'|'twoleft'|'tworight'] | ['hide', who] | ['present', [who,...]] | ['codec', call_id] | ['sfx', ks_sfx_name] | ['hint', text] | ['pause', seconds]

rows.title: Virtuous Mission
ops: 1964. Somewhere beyond the Iron Curtain, in a closed city the maps call "Yamakugrad".
A parachute opens over a snowy forest. The man under it has a bandana, a knife, and a forged transfer certificate in the name of one Hisao Nakai.
Snake stows the parachute under a pine and checks the certificate. "Heart condition. Arrhythmia." Convenient. Nobody asks a sick boy too many questions.
Press C (or the CAMO button) at any time to change camouflage. Whoever you're talking to will notice.

rows.title: Transfer Student
ops: The school gate looks exactly like a Japanese boarding school. That is the first thing that's wrong with it.
The second is the hammer and sickle worked very subtly into the ironwork. The third is the wheelchair ramp. It is beautiful. It is gold-leafed.

rows.title: The Sign
ops: Ah! You must be the new transfer student, Hicchan~! I'm Misha, and this is Shicchan, our class rep!
[[ You are late. Transfer students are never late. Spies are late. ]
That's not what her hands said.
Snake reads a lot of things. Codebooks. Body language. The fact that Misha's "translation" just skipped forty words.
Hicchan, Shicchan wants to know if you'd like to join the student council~! We do a lot of very normal school things! Like budgets!
[[ Very large budgets. For other countries. ]

rows.title: Instructor Mutovich
ops: Class, this is Hisao Nakai. He has a heart condition, so please do not startle him.
Today we continue our unit on "Infrastructure of the Capitalist West, and its Weaknesses". Turn to page 1990.
Page 1990 is a diagram of an American bus. Someone has drawn a lift on the back of it in red crayon and written "SOON".
A very important year, Nakai. You'll see.

rows.title: The Stride
ops: Something hits Snake at roughly the speed of a Soviet motorcycle. He rolls with it, the way they taught him. The something does not roll. The something bounces.
Ow! Watch where you're standing! This is a running track, not a standing track!
That's kind of my whole thing! Emi Ibarazaki, fastest legs in the Union. Both of them carbon fibre.
Our coach says the Americans will pay a fortune to make every pavement in their country flat enough for me. Every. Single. One.
Because it's the right thing to do, silly! That's what makes it such a good plan.

rows.title: The Whisper and The Braille
ops: The library is quiet. A purple-haired girl is reading a thick book titled "Building Codes of the United States, Annotated". She has annotated it in very small, very neat handwriting.
O-oh. H-hello. I'm... Hanako. I don't... usually talk to... people who walk that quietly.
There you are, Hanako. And you've brought someone. Footsteps like that... military, I'd say. Or a cat.
Lilly Satou. Head of the class 3-3 reading committee. And of a few other committees.
Braille signage regulations, for every elevator in Washington D.C. Do you know how many elevators that is, Mr. Nakai?
Th-thousands. Each one needs... raised numbers. Every button. It will cost... so much.
Hanako is our accountant. She is very good at large numbers.

rows.title: The Brush
ops: On the roof, a girl with no arms is painting with her feet. The painting is enormous. The painting is a ramp.
You're standing in my light, but it's okay, because you're the kind of shadow I wanted.
It's a mural. Or a blueprint. They told me to paint a blueprint and I said I only paint murals, so we agreed it's both.
It's a ramp at a one-to-twelve slope. If you build a million of them, a country gets very tired.
The student council. The blueprints are in their room. In a drawer marked "NOT BLUEPRINTS".

rows.title: Snake Eater
ops: Night. The student council room. Snake moves between the desks like he was never there.

The drawer marked "NOT BLUEPRINTS" contains blueprints. A thousand pages. On the cover, in English: "A BILL to establish a clear and comprehensive prohibition of discrimination on the basis of disability."
The Americans with Disabilities Act... drafted in 1964. In Russian. With footnotes.
[[ Good evening, Nakai. Or should I say... Snake. ]
Shicchan says she read your file! And your lips! Wahahaha~!
Told you I'm fast. I beat you here by six minutes.
We heard you come in. Well, I did.
W-we've... been expecting you... for twenty-six years. Th-that's how long... the plan takes.
I painted you into the mural already. You're the man at the bottom of the ramp, looking up.
[[ The Cobra Unit is retired. Meet the Kerb Unit. ]
